MHANY offers 1st time homeowner workshops:

First Time Home Buyer Workshops

Buying your first home is a big step—one that’s easier, safer, and more achievable when you have the right guidance. MHANY’s First-Time Homebuyer Workshop is offered either via Zoom or in person at our office, and lasts approximately two hours. Every prospective buyer must attend this workshop/seminar as part of their homeownership journey.

﻿

After completing the workshop and a minimum of 8 hours of one-on-one counseling with a HUD-certified MHANY counselor, participants become eligible for a HUD Counseling Certificate—a credential recognized by lenders and required for many down-payment assistance programs.

The Neighborhood

Fort Washington Park & Hudson River


“Nature and waterfront recreation right in Upper Manhattan.”


Fort Washington Park gives residents access to walking paths, open green space, waterfront views and recreation along the Hudson River.

Button

George Washington Bridge


“Iconic New York views at your doorstep.”


The George Washington Bridge is one of Upper Manhattan's most recognizable landmarks and provides a dramatic backdrop to the neighborhood.

Button

Little Red Lighthouse


“Discover one of Manhattan's hidden historic gems.”


The Little Red Lighthouse sits beneath the George Washington Bridge along the Hudson River and is one of the area's most distinctive landmarks.

Button

The Cloisters & Fort Tryon Park


“Culture, gardens and history just uptown.”


The Cloisters, part of The Metropolitan Museum of Art, provides an exceptional cultural destination within Fort Tryon Park.

Button

Audubon Terrace


“Surrounded by history, architecture and culture.”


Audubon Terrace is an important historic and cultural destination in Washington Heights, with impressive Beaux-Arts architecture.

Button

Neighborhood Lifestyle


“A vibrant neighborhood with a culture all its own.”


The surrounding Washington Heights community offers restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, shopping and everyday services, with a particularly strong Dominican and Latino cultural presence.

Button

Schools & Education

Convenient Access to Schools

Current property information identifies several nearby schools, including P.S. 4 Duke Ellington, Community Math & Science Prep, Community Health Academy of the Heights, St. Rose of Lima School and Gregorio Luperon High School for Science and Mathematics.

Nearby schools include:

  • P.S. 004 Duke Ellington -Elementary school
  • Community Math & Science Prep -Middle school
  • Community Health Academy of the Heights -High school
  • Gregorio Luperon High School for Science and Mathematics -High school
  • WHIN Music Community Charter School -Charter school
